tasks.spec:
You are fixing one bug in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no model call: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY storygame/runtime/observation.py and tests/test_observation_context.py (append one test; change no existing assertion). Never touch packages/, data/, docs/, worker/, other modules.

BUG: storygame/runtime/observation.py decides what counts as an observable item with `world.kind(entity_id) == "thing"` (an exact-kind match) in _candidate_ids, _required_ids, build_observation_context and _contingent_ids. A story kind that inherits `thing`, e.g. schema kinds `[{"id": "gadget", "is": ["thing"]}]` with an entity `probe` of kind gadget on a supporter `bench`, is therefore silently dropped: inspecting the bench lists only the plain-kind cup. Story packages define their own item kinds, so this loses real items.

FIX: add one private helper `_is_item(world, entity_id)` that is true when `world.is_a(entity_id, "thing")` and the entity is not a structural kind, i.e. not `world.is_a(entity_id, k)` for any k in ("container", "supporter", "furniture", "vehicle"). Replace every exact-kind check for items with it (keep seats, drawers, tables, and vehicles excluded exactly as today). No story vocabulary. TEST FIRST: append to tests/test_observation_context.py a plain (non-xfail) test that builds a World from a schema dict with the gadget kind above (kinds format is a LIST of {id, is}; look at worldkeeper WorldSchema.from_data), puts the observer in an area, the bench in the area, `probe` (gadget) and `cup` (thing) on the bench, then asserts for ObservationRequest('Inspect the bench.', 'look', bench) that required == ('cup', 'probe') and both appear in visible_things, and that the bench itself is in neither. Run it, see it fail, then fix. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files. Report pass counts.
